newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan opposes tax cuts that add to deficit.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan opposes tax cuts that add to deficit.

text.p: Federal Reserve Board Chairman Alan Greenspan on Thursday said he would not favor tax cuts that would add to the budget deficit.
In testimony bofore the Joint Economic Committee of Congress, Greenspan was asked whether he would put reducing the deficit ahead of a tax cut.
"I've testified to that issue affirmatively before and I would continue it," he said.
Greenspan also said that, so far, increases in wages have been matched by increases in productivity, adding that there was some evidence that productivity was on the rise.
